title: Surreal Ghost Tea Party
description: A surreal stained-glass style scene inside a dark greenhouse with cracked panes. A large distressed ghost with dripping orange and purple paint stands on a mossy floor beside a green patterned dog, while a woman's half-face adorned with flowers drips black liquid; the background shows koi ponds, cherry blossoms, and ornate buildings under a celestial sun with runes.
prompt: Surreal scene set inside a dark cracked greenhouse with arched windows revealing cherry blossom trees, koi ponds and ornate domed buildings. A large purple ghost with wide eyes and dripping orange paint stands in the center. To the left is a woman's half-face with black dripping eyes wearing a crown of colorful flowers. A green patterned dog stands nearby. Tea set and chairs on a mossy floor with purple and orange paint dripping everywhere. Celestial sun with runes in the top stained glass panel. Psychedelic dripping paint aesthetic.
